shortDescription: Remove files matching a pattern from a directory

options.name: path
options.description: Path to the directory where files should be removed. This must be an existing directory.

options.name: pattern
options.description: Pattern to match files for removal. Supports wildcards (V(*), V(?), V([seq]), V([!seq])) for glob-style matching. Use O(use_regex=true) to interpret this as a regular expression instead.

options.name: recursive
options.description: If V(true), search for files recursively in subdirectories. If V(false), only files in the specified directory are removed.

options.name: use_regex
options.description: If V(true), O(pattern) is interpreted as a regular expression. If V(false), O(pattern) is interpreted as a glob-style wildcard pattern.
